### The fence gap

The surviving filter is now caught. The harness's two-league world already gives every league one walk-up of unknown age (`walkUpPersonId`: no date, no tick, a roster place added at a scorer's table), so the answer was "yes" in every run with the filter or without it; nothing was added to the world. The case now does what the `hasRecordedChild` case does: in another league's runs the scope's own people of unknown age are ticked adults inside a savepoint (`setOwnPeopleApart` in `people-cases.test-helper.ts`, shared by both cases), so only the target's walk-up could make the answer "yes" and only the league filter keeps it "no". Run and passed: `fence-filter-check` on the lane's query files (16 filters taken out, 0 problems; `person-summary` and `minor-by-age-sql` excused as before, `index` is not a query), `isolation` and the role matrix (6 files, 1252 tests), `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`.
